content:
Claude Code for engineers, Claude Cowork for business artefacts, and ChatGPT / OpenAI Agents for team-wide copilots — mapped with governance, not hype.

Anthropic’s Claude Cowork product (claude.com/product/cowork) targets scheduled decks, docs, and spreadsheets with desk-to-phone check-in. Claude Code targets repo-scale coding agents. OpenAI ChatGPT Team/Enterprise plus the Agents SDK cover GTM, support, and custom builders — with current API classes including GPT-5.6 and GPT-6 families.

TenthMatrix’s products hub now has a dedicated section. The full matrix by team, controls, and related security patterns is in the technical article.
